laura_pm: Quick heads-up — we need to lock a go/no-go meeting for Release 2024.10. Cut date is Fri Aug 9 EOD. Proposing Wed Aug 7 16:00 PT for a 30m sync. Agenda draft below, pls ack who needs to attend.

ben_eng: 16:00 PT works for me. Should we include canary owners? Also request a brief perf summary.

sophie_sre: I can present infra readiness. Can we move to 15:30 PT? 16:00 conflicts with another on my calendar.

matt_product: 15:30 PT is fine. I'll invite PMs and sales SLA owner. Need ops and legal for private deploy customers?

laura_pm: Good — how about 15:30 PT then. Agenda (30m):
```
1) Quick status: build + integration (5m) — ben
2) Infra & canary plan (7m) — sophie
3) Risk checklist + open blockers (7m) — laura
4) Rollout plan & rollback criteria (6m) — matt
5) Final go/no-go vote + actions (5m) — laura
```
Please add any blockers in-thread. Required attendees: eng leads, SRE, product, release manager, legal (if private customers), support triage lead.

jenna_support: tagging support — I'll be there. Do we need an on-call engineer present for the first hour post-launch?

sophie_sre: yes, recommend on-call + canary owner for first 2 hours.

ben_eng: build is green but there's one flaky e2e failing intermittently (ticket #1234). Not blocking release unless it regresses. I'll pair with QA to triage tomorrow.

laura_pm: thanks. Can folks react with :thumbsup: to confirm 15:30 PT or reply with alternate times. If no response by Tue EOD we'll assume 15:30.

deploy-bot: calendar invite created: Wed Aug 7 15:30 PT — 'Go/No-Go: Release 2024.10' — attendees added: laura_pm, ben_eng, sophie_sre, matt_product, jenna_support

ben_eng: :thumbsup:

matt_product: :thumbsup:

sophie_sre: :thumbsup:

jenna_support: :thumbsup: I'll prep a triage doc and link it in thread before the meeting.

laura_pm: added a short prep checklist to the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/release-2024.10/checklist — please fill items you own by Tue 12:00 PT.

maria_legal: I'll join if there are customer-specific IP or contract items. rn looks like not required but keep me in the loop.

laura_pm: noted — thanks all. I'll send final agenda + calendar update tomorrow morning.
